findings.summary: IC power pin U101.4 (VS-) has no DC path to a power rail (net '-4V0A')
findings.description: Pin U101.4 (VS-) is type=power_in on net '-4V0A'. Graph walk (≤2 hops, rejecting capacitor edges, accepting resistors≤1Ω, inductors, ferrite beads, bridged solder jumpers) did not reach a named power rail. The pin is likely AC-coupled to ground only — the IC will not power up reliably.
findings.recommendation: Verify the schematic for this pin: the DC route must go through a conducting element (direct wire, 0Ω resistor, inductor, ferrite bead, or bridged solder jumper) — not a capacitor. If the intent was to tie VCC through an LC filter, add the missing inductor or 0Ω in series.

report_context.impact: IC supply floats DC; board will not run.

top_issues.summary: IC power pin U101.4 (VS-) has no DC path to a power rail (net '-4V0A')
top_issues.description: Pin U101.4 (VS-) is type=power_in on net '-4V0A'. Graph walk (≤2 hops, rejecting capacitor edges, accepting resistors≤1Ω, inductors, ferrite beads, bridged solder jumpers) did not reach a named power rail. The pin is likely AC-coupled to ground only — the IC will not power up reliably.
top_issues.recommendation: Verify the schematic for this pin: the DC route must go through a conducting element (direct wire, 0Ω resistor, inductor, ferrite bead, or bridged solder jumper) — not a capacitor. If the intent was to tie VCC through an LC filter, add the missing inductor or 0Ω in series.

report_context.impact: IC supply floats DC; board will not run.
